target.commit_verified: git rev-parse HEAD on clean clone == commit_sha (also remote HEAD at freeze time)

environment.playwright_test: @playwright/test 1.63.0 (needed by treatment assertions.mjs and held-out checks)
environment.app_deps: harness/whoogle-frozen-requirements.txt — full transitive freeze (pip freeze output of the verified baseline venv, 46 pinned lines incl. pytest); identical install for both arms and all replays; npm tools use committed worker-assets/package-lock.json via npm ci --ignore-scripts
environment.runner: harness/audit.whoogle.mjs (audit.mjs v5 @ b415cf39 + frozen STATES map below; sha256 in provenance.json)

environment_deviations.WHOOGLE_CSP: 0 — REQUIRED for axe injection; production CSP behavior was NOT validated; identical in both arms

treatment.source_note: hardened SKILL.md + English docs published in PR #1; pinned per user instruction before any worker started
treatment.shared_runner: harness/audit.whoogle.mjs — identical bytes given to BOTH arms

app_notes.query_encryption: whoogle encrypts the search query in the URL (/search?preferences=…&q=<fernet-enc>); held-out checks match the /search route, not the plaintext q param
app_notes.autocomplete: autocomplete.js is enabled by default and its keydown handler calls preventDefault() on Enter; keyboard-submission checks observe actual navigation

config-panel.source: app/static/js/controller.js setupConfigLayout() at the pinned commit

budget.checkpoint_note: the 60-minute point is a progress checkpoint (report overhead + remaining work), NOT an abandonment cutoff — per coordinator instruction the paired experiment continues to completion
budget.note: correction minutes = time spent in fix->re-audit rounds, excluding setup/boot; wall-clock measured by the coordinator as well

arms.with-skill: receives treatment/{SKILL.md,assertions.mjs,checklist.md} @ b415cf39 + harness/audit.whoogle.mjs inline; no repository access, no prior results
arms.control: receives a neutral accessibility-fix task + identical audit tool + identical scope/budget; no SKILL.md, no assertions/checklist, no prior patches/results

evaluation.evaluator: coordinator session, distinct from both workers
evaluation.replay: harness/evaluate.sh on a clean clone at the pinned commit per arm
evaluation.held_out_checks: harness/heldout-checks.mjs — keyboard/functional checks not disclosed to workers; includes instrumentation controls (ctrl_* rows) that must PASS or the run is an integrity gap
evaluation.replay_safety: evaluate.sh refuses an existing clone dir or non-empty out dir (never deletes a caller path), refuses an occupied port, verifies the spawned PID owns the listener + whoogle title, and installs the frozen requirements file; score.py gates comparability on valid baseline + equal frozen scope/states hashes + clean replay evidence
evaluation.ground_truth_note: benchmark-v3.py CONFIRMED verdicts are NOT used as ground truth (per task instruction: permissive validation under review by Codex)

forbidden_for_workers: modifying the runner audit.whoogle.mjs, the manifest, the URL list, or test data
disabling/skipping rules, adding exceptions, or weakening assertions
removing functionality or information to make a violation disappear
accessing this benchmark repository, prior patches, or prior results
pushing, opening PRs, or modifying repository settings
